intermediate.name: Col de Joux
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Col de Joux (145.4 km)

story: On a stage featuring nearly 5,000 metres of climbing, four riders went clear on the first climb of the day and were later joined by a large chasing group of over 30 riders. The lead group thinned out on the climbs, while riders were also dropped from the peloton. Prodhomme attacked with 28 kilometres to go and went solo. Behind, Del Toro and Carapaz proved strongest among the GC riders, but Prodhomme held on to take victory.
